problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:

* Component A: volume 41 m³
* Component B: volume 32 m³
* Component C: volume 63 m³
* Component D: volume 41 m³
* Component E: volume 40 m³
* Component F: volume 57 m³
* Component G: volume 42 m³
* Component H: volume 49 m³
* Component I: volume 68 m³
* Component J: volume 64 m³
* Component K: volume 67 m³
* Component L: volume 33 m³
* Component M: volume 33 m³
* Component N: volume 44 m³
* Component O: volume 31 m³
* Component P: volume 66 m³
* Component Q: volume 53 m³
* Component R: volume 46 m³
* Component S: volume 59 m³
* Component T: volume 69 m³
* Component U: volume 48 m³
* Component V: volume 47 m³
* Component W: volume 63 m³
* Component X: volume 51 m³
* Component Y: volume 53 m³
* Component Z: volume 38 m³
* Component [: volume 34 m³
* Component \: volume 58 m³
* Component ]: volume 64 m³
* Component ^: volume 37 m³
* Component _: volume 36 m³
* Component `: volume 39 m³
* Component a: volume 40 m³
* Component b: volume 51 m³
* Component c: volume 56 m³

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 m³ of volume. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
